messages:
sam.partnerships: OpenWeightsCo uploaded ModelX_v2 artifacts. LICENSE.md says 'research-only' / non-commercial. We need a quick alignment: what can we offer partners? marketplace listing, hosted API, Dedicated, SI installs?
tara-legal: Research-only blocks commercial listing and Dedicated resale. We can propose a Distribution License Addendum (DLA) that permits hosting and distribution of compiled runtime artifacts but forbids raw checkpoint redistribution. Must include export compliance statements.
nate-eng: Tech ask: we need signed SHA256 manifest, provenance (build steps, converter versions), and either kernel source or a redistributable binary with checksum. Also a small eval set for parity checks after quantization.
anya-ops: Ops: do not accept cross-account CI roles. Ask for presigned uploads and time-limited access, plus object checksums. For SI lane, if they deny raw weights, we can ship an installer image under license but need permission to distribute to SI customers.
ben-partners: I'll propose two lanes to OWCo: 1) Hosted + Marketplace (DLA + manifest + hosting license) 2) SI/Dedicated (DLA + SOW + KYC). I'll ask them to fill a checklist: license acceptance, manifest, kernel binary/source, eval set, export declarations.
claudia-ml: Add kernel disclosure (fused-attn closed-source?) and compatibility matrix (context length, tokenizer norms, FP16/INT8). We'll need perf numbers for model profile.
tara-legal: Starter clause for email: "Supplier grants Redwood a non-exclusive, worldwide, sublicensable license to host and distribute compiled runtime artifacts; redistribution of raw checkpoints prohibited. Each release must include signed manifest (SHA256) and provenance. Supplier to disclose export controls."
sam.partnerships: Ben send draft to OWCo legal + eng and post replies here. Aim to finalize DLA in 2 weeks to hit marketing announcement window.
deploy-bot: created JIRA PARTNERS-421 assigned to ben-partners.
